summary: Build practical middle management skills for AI adoption, data-led decisions, and hybrid teams. Explore the course and enrol today.
lede: Middle management in AI-enabled and hybrid workplaces connects organisational priorities with team decisions, workflows and delivery. For early and experienced managers, the course develops practical skills in interpreting dashboards, setting priorities and accountability, coordinating hybrid team rhythms, and applying human review and responsible controls to AI-assisted work; it also covers change fatigue, psychological safety and stakeholder alignment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for a modern middle manager who translates organisational priorities into team delivery, people decisions, and responsible digital adoption. It suits early and experienced managers who need practical tools rather than a senior executive strategy programme.
audience: Functional Supervisors using operational data to allocate
Public Service and NGO Programme Leads
prerequisites: Prior experience supervising people, projects, programmes, or functional work is recommended. You should bring a real or representative team-management challenge involving hybrid work, data use, AI adoption, or organisational change. No coding or programming is required. You need basic spreadsheet literacy and access to a laptop for digital templates and dashboard exercises; advanced analytics, software configuration, and AI model development are outside the course scope.
